name: plan
description: Use when you want to create or update a project plan. Breaks down goals into tasks and milestones.

name: po
description: Use when you need product-owner-level decisions or backlog prioritization. Evaluates trade-offs and sets sprint scope.

name: storm
description: Use when brainstorming ideas, exploring solution space, or generating creative options before committing to a direction.

name: build
description: Use when you want to implement a feature or write code. Produces working code from a spec or task description.

name: review
description: Use when you want code or output reviewed for quality, correctness, or best practices. Returns structured feedback.

name: test
description: Use when you want automated tests written or run. Covers unit, integration, and edge-case scenarios.

name: retro
description: Use to run a retrospective on a completed sprint or task. Surfaces what went well, what didn't, and action items.

name: explore
description: Use when you want to investigate an unfamiliar codebase, library, or concept. Returns a structured summary of findings.

name: debug
description: Use when you have a failing test, error, or unexpected behavior. Diagnoses root cause and proposes a fix.

name: design
description: Use when you need architecture or system design decisions. Produces diagrams, interface contracts, or component sketches.

name: fix
description: Use when you have a specific known bug to patch. Applies a targeted fix without broader refactoring.

name: status
description: Use to get a quick snapshot of current pipeline state, open tasks, and recent activity.

name: log
description: Use to view a structured log of past agent actions, decisions, and outputs for auditing or context.

name: end
description: Use to cleanly close out a feature, sprint, or session. Archives artifacts and marks work as complete.
